Hello members of MSstats group,

I work with DDA spectra in label free, and 
I found the R code using with MSstats for GroupComparison function,
but the function fit.model or fit.model.single are hidden functions.

I would know if it is possible to know, how the Fold Change (Log2FC) is measured ? 
Is it a mean of the FC of all features for a protein?
Does the P.value take into account if there is a percentage of the features number by protein that have a significative fold change? or not?
Does the P.value take into account the abundance standard deviation between run ?

Thanks in advance for your answer.

Regards

Chloé
